services.name: Landscaping
services.description: Weekly mowing and trimming, edging, fertilizer and weed control, bush and hedge trimming, mulch, sod, planting, and spring and fall clean-ups.

services.name: Concrete
services.description: New sidewalks, driveways, patios and stoops, curb cut repair, pavers and retaining walls. Old concrete removed and hauled away.

services.name: Construction & repairs
services.description: Soffit, siding and trim, rotten board replacement, drywall and painting, laminate flooring, tubs and showers, fences, decks, doors, lights and faucets.

services.name: Snow removal
services.description: Driveway and lot plowing, sidewalk clearing and salting, by the storm or on a seasonal contract, with clear pricing by snowfall.

faq.q: How do I get a quote or estimate price?
faq.a: Call or text (815) 289-1149, or fill out the quote form on the Contact page. Maurice will get back to you with a written proposal and the price before any work starts.

faq.q: What areas towns do you serve work in?
faq.a: We work in Rockford, Loves Park, Machesney Park, Roscoe, Rockton and Cherry Valley. Outside those towns? Call or text (815) 289-1149 and ask.

faq.q: Do you do snow removal plowing salting?
faq.a: Yes. We plow driveways and lots, clear sidewalks and put down salt. You can pay by the storm or get a seasonal contract, priced by snowfall: 2 to 4 inches, 4 to 7 inches and 7 to 10 inches.

faq.q: Do you work with HOAs condo townhome associations property managers commercial?
faq.a: Yes. We do seasonal contracts for associations: mowing, fertilizer, shrubs, mulch, gutters and snow removal on one monthly price, with written proposals for your board.

faq.q: Do you pour concrete sidewalks driveways patios?
faq.a: Yes. We pour new sidewalks, driveways, patios and stoops, repair curb cuts, and remove and haul away old concrete.

faq.q: Do you do repairs inside the house drywall painting flooring bathroom?
faq.a: Yes. Drywall and patching, painting, laminate flooring, tubs and showers, doors, lights, faucets and toilets. Call or text to describe the job.

faq.q: Hablan espanol? Do you speak Spanish?
faq.a: Sí. Maurice habla español. Llame o mande texto al (815) 289-1149.

faq.q: How do I pay checks payment?
faq.a: Checks are made payable to Raul M Rodriguez. Payment terms are written on your proposal or invoice.
